label: Suspects Arrested (Total)
contestNote: Includes 10+ arrests in Nov 2025 from phone-record analysis, 4 more in Jun 2026 tied to the disputed Iguala funeral-home cremation line, and former Guerrero Governor Ángel Aguirre Rivero's Aug 6, 2026 arrest — the highest-ranking civilian official charged in the case to date.
